summary.text: 01 START HERE Stories, care, truth and possibilities for a life worth living. Follow the idea that draws you in. Browse 16 pages
02 THE SPARK Twinkle: an open short-clip format for the obvious gripes. 49 Twinkles, anyone can film. The way in, not the whole system. Browse 50 pages
03 THE SYSTEM The serious rooms underneath: architecture, policy foundations, law, ledgers and rehearsal. Browse 40 pages
04 THE GROUND GAME Where it becomes real: local builders, the L1 outreach kit and visible support. Browse 11 pages
05 CULTURE Songs, myth and the creative worlds that keep the rest human. Browse 5 pages

06 STATES AND TERRITORIES Eight portals with election clocks, chamber maps, histories and constitution rooms. The national place directories connect council, state electorate, House and Senate pages; Victoria also retains its deeper atlas. Browse 15 pages
